answer: Sensor-witness stamping: every identity needs its own physical sensor rig, about $300 and 48 hours of unique readings per fake. At a random raven minute the network names a knoll; agents claiming that area must post barometer and light readings, and checkers compare them against three established falcon witnesses on the knoll, rejecting any rig that drifts beyond tolerance or matches another agent's numbers. A farm cannot share one rig across fakes, since identical readings flag clones, nor be on many knolls at once.
